# Issue-history distillation template

Preserve the full thread for audit, but give an agent this reviewed current-state packet:

```markdown
# Current problem and observed behavior
# Current acceptance criteria
# Current non-goals
# Current authoritative decisions
# Open questions
# Rejected or superseded approaches
# Minimal selected historical links
# Owner and next review date
```

The distillation becomes authority only after an accountable owner reviews it.
